card.name: Digits in infusion rates, before drops
card.fires_on: Numbers (often the digit 0 or 6, or a space before a number) in intravenous infusion rates and drip-set settings, where 'drops' or 'microdrops' or a rate unit is expected next. Also a few spots right before 'drop' of liquid.

modes.label: Infusion rate numbers
modes.description: Digits inside rates for infusion or injection, such as 60 or 20, just before units like mg/min or microdrops.
modes.example: The rate of intravenous injection for adults should not exceed 6<<0>> mg/min for phenobarbital sodium

modes.label: Drip chamber settings
modes.description: The space or digit before microdrops/mL in drip-set descriptions.
modes.example: a drip chamber that delivers approximately<< >>60 microdrops/mL.

modes.label: A drop of liquid
modes.description: Words leading to a drop of liquid or rain falling.
modes.example: a drop of drug solution is<< seen>> at the needle tip

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like 'drops' and 'drop' and away from unrelated rare tokens.
card.plain: It lights up on numbers in IV rate instructions where drops per minute or a drop of liquid is coming up.
